stem_book: A particle is projected with velocity v₀ along x-axis. The deceleration on the particle is proportional to the square of the distance from the origin, i.e., a = αx². The distance at which the particle stops is: (a) √(3v₀/2α) (b) (3v₀/2α)^(1/3) (c) √(2v₀²/3α) (d) (3v₀²/2α)^(1/3)
reason: Official key B (3v₀/2α)^(1/3) is dimensionally wrong; working gives D (3v₀²/2α)^(1/3). Manifest key text had D's value but the printed letter is B.
